source: work.task_event (content-free) + work.member seats; computed per org_id, never per user in dashboards

activation.definition: org is activated when >=3 distinct seated members submit >=1 task within 14 days of the org flag turning on
activation.numerator: distinct subjects with task.submitted within 14d of enablement

technical_success_rate.definition: run.succeeded / (run.succeeded + run.failed) for tasks submitted in the 14-day pilot window; user-canceled runs are excluded (#32 A - window-scoped like activation)

acceptance_rate.definition: tasks with task.completed basis=version / tasks that reached task.awaiting_acceptance, both scoped to tasks submitted in the 14-day pilot window (#32 A - window-scoped like activation)

artifact_success_rate.definition: tasks submitted in the window that have at least one artifact.published / tasks submitted in the window; this is D5 §10's own wording for technical success ('有发布成果'), kept beside technical_success_rate rather than replacing it because the run-outcome form is the signed go_gate

continued_after_acceptance.definition: accepted tasks (task.completed basis=version) that show further work on the same task AFTER their own acceptance event - artifact.published, task.title_update or another run - over accepted tasks; D5 §10's '采纳后继续'
continued_after_acceptance.ordering: work.task_event.seq, not created_at: seq is unique per task and strictly increasing, so an edit made before the acceptance can never be read as continuation

reason_completion_share.definition: task.completed basis=reason / all task.completed; high values mean outputs are not used

time_to_first_artifact_p50_seconds.definition: median of first artifact.published minus task.submitted per task

golden_suite_pass_ratio.definition: golden tasks meeting pass_rule / all golden tasks (golden-tasks.json)
